description: She wears a plum-purple woven floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-tan geometric and plant-pattern borders run around the neckline, bodice seams, cuffs, front skirt lines and hem. A narrow worked girdle has a round clasp and hanging metal ornaments. A cream draped wrap with matching purple-and-gold edging rests around the forearms. Small gold earrings and low patterned shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
